senses.gloss:
चुल् चुल्, cl. 10. P. चोलयति, -यितुम्, to
raise, elevate; to rise, increase; to dip,
dive into; [cf. बुल्.]

चुल्ल् चुल्ल्, cl. 1. P. चुल्लति, &c., to play,
sport, dally, wanton, coquet; to con-
jecture; manifest one's meaning (?).

चुलका चुलका, f., N. of a river; (also read
चुलुका.)

चुल्लक चुल्लक, अस्, m. (for चुलुक), the
palm of the hand hollowed as if to hold water.

चुलुक चुलुक, अस्, m. deep mud or mire;
a mouthful of water, the hand hollowed to hold
water; a small vessel or pot, a gallipot &c.; N. of a
man; (आ), f. = चुलका; (अम्), n. water in which
pulse has been steeped; [cf. चलुक.]

चुलुकिन्, ई, m. a porpoise, sea-hog, or similar
animal; [cf. उलुपिन्, चुल्लकी, चुलुम्पिन्.]

चुलुम्प् चुलुम्प्, cl. 1. P. चुलुम्पति, &c.,
to swing, rock; to cut (?), to dis-
appear, to be lost (?).

चुलुम्प, अस्, m. fondling or nursing children;
(आ), f. a she-goat.

चुलुम्पिन् or चुलूपिन्, ई, m. = चुलुकिन्, a Gangetic
porpoise, sea-hog, or similar animal.

चुल्ल चुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, blear-eyed; (अस्), m.
a blear eye; [cf. चिल्ल and पिल्ल.]

चूल चूल, अस्, m. (= चूड, q. v.), N. of a
[]
man; (आ), f. an upper room, a room on the top of a
house; a crest, see चूडा; the top part or crest of a
comet; [cf. उच्-चूल; cf. also Gr. σκόλλυς.]

चुल्लकी, f. a kind of water-pot; a porpoise, sea-
[]
hog [cf. चुलुकिन्]; N. of a family; a sort of tribe
or caste (?); the opposite bank of a river (?).
चुल्लि चुल्लि, इस्, f. a fire-place, chimney.

चुल्ली, f. a fire-place, chimney; a funeral pile; a
large apartment or hall composed of three wings or
divisions, one looking north, another east, and the
third west.

चूलिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (आ), f. the
crest or comb of a cock; the root of an elephant's
ear; N. of a metre; a particular part or division of
a drama, the body of a drama, the inferior personages
of the drama collectively; title of a Jaina work form-
ing one of the five parts of the Dṛṣṭi-vāda; (अम्),
n. cakes of flour fried with ghee.
—चूलिका-पैशाची,
f., N. of a particular dialect in the drama.
—चूलिको-
पनिषद् (˚का-उप्˚), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.

चूलिका, f.; add — the hinting of a matter or event
by those behind the curtain (in the drama).

चूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a crest (as a bird) or an
ornament on the head; (ई), m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
